item.title: Board Game Night Without a Game Room: Set Up and Reset in 15 Minutes
item.description: Most small living rooms do not fail board game night because the games are too big. They fail because nobody measured the table that is actually in the room, nobody planned where the chairs and the walkway go, and the game is still half-spread across the coffee table at midnight. This guide starts from the surface you own, matches a game to it, and ends with a short reset that returns the room to everyday use.
